name: muhkoo
description: Muhkoo's Claude Code plugins — build full applications on the Muhkoo platform.

plugins.name: muhkoo-app-builder
plugins.description: Describe an app idea and build it end-to-end on Muhkoo: provision the backend (ZK auth, database, channels, agents, functions), scaffold a Vite + React client against @muhkoo/connect, run an end-to-end Cypress suite, and apply a frontend-design pass.
